items.body: While Nvidia is only allowed to sell its most advanced AI chips to whitelisted companies, it appears that two of its Californian customers are actually fronts for Chinese companies. Further, one of the Californian companies was renamed after its Chinese parent company was blacklisted, CBS News reports . The other one, which is on Nvidia's list of "preferred partners," is owned by a Chinese firm whose CEO graduated from a Chinese military university. It's reported that U.S.-based, Chinese-owned companies have been used as a way to work around export controls designed to prevent Nvidia's chips from being sold wholesale to China. Chips are routinely sold to companies in the U.S. before being leased or shipped to other companies in Southeast Asia. While Nvidia isn't allowed to sell its most capable AI chips to China, it can still do business with the country. It can sell graphics cards for use in personal gaming PCs as well as AI chips that don't use the company's latest, most capable technologies. items.body: كانت الجولة الحادية عشرة من دوري جوي للنخبة (الدوري السعودي تحت 21 عامًا) بمثابة جولة سقوط الكبار، حيث انتهى فيها السجل المثالي لفريقي الاتحاد والأهلي، من حيث عدم التعرض لأي هزيمة. وأقيمت مباريات الجولة الحادية عشرة من دوري جوي للنخبة على مدار 4 أيام، بدأت منذ يوم الإثنين الماضي الموافق 23 نوفمبر/تشرين الثاني الجاري، واستمرت حتى اليوم الخميس الموافق 26 من الشهر نفسه. البطل يذيق الاتحاد أول هزيمة المفاجأة الأكبر في تلك الجولة تمثلت في الهزيمة التي تعرض لها الاتحاد، متصدر الترتيب، أمام فريق الحزم، حامل لقب النسخة الماضية من دوري جوي للنخبة، بنتيجة 1-2، رغم خوض المباراة في جدة. الغريب أن الاتحاد هو من افتتح التسجيل، عن طريق لاعبه عبدالعزيز الشمري في الدقيقة 27، وظل متقدمًا في النتيجة حتى قبل 10 دقائق من نهاية الوقت الأصلي. لكن الحزم قلب الطاولة بشكل مفاجئ، بفضل حسان إدريس، نجم نهائي النسخة الماضية من الدوري السعودي تحت 21 عامًا، حيث سجل هدف التعادل في الدقيقة 80 من عمر المباراة. وفي الدقيقة الثامنة من الوقت بدل الضائع، فجر المهاجم السنغالي أمادو بامبا ديانج مفاجأة الموسم، بعدما سجل هدف الفوز القاتل لفريق الحزم، بتسديدة قوية من على حدود منطقة الجزاء. بهدفين لهدف ⚽️⚽️ الحزم ينتصر على الاتحاد ✅ ملخص اللقاء 🎞️ #دوري_جوي_للنخبةU21 pic.twitter.com/GoTpanfKAd — U21 دوري جوّي للنخبة (@SEL_U…

items.body: S&P Global Ratings, one of the world’s largest rating agencies, announced that it’s putting Nvidia’s credit rating on watch as the company faces a possible downgrade. The agency says that the issues surrounding Jensen Huang regarding export control violations, as well as his resignation and subsequent reinstatement 11 days later, reveal the weakness of Nvidia’s management team and board oversight. “We believe the long tenure of certain board members may have compromised their independence,” the rating agency said in its press release. It also added, “Issues related to Nvidia’s China exposure also raise questions regarding geopolitical risk management and internal controls. While Nvidia management has delivered significant returns for its stakeholders over decades, weak executive oversight and lack of succession planning have brought questions around the ‘key man’ risk to the forefront. items.title: Exploring the Indium phosphide supply chain — the material constraint tightening the optical interconnect bottleneck
items.summary: The AI industry's shift to optical interconnects is overwhelming the concentrated InP supply chain behind lasers, transceivers, and co-packaged optics.
items.body: Indium phosphide (InP) is a compound material used in specialized chip-making. Unlike silicon, which is the fundamental building block for mainstream logic and memory chips, InP — made from indium and phosphorus — is mainly used to manufacture highly specialized photonic and high-frequency electronic chips, largely due to its outstanding optical properties. Its immensely expensive and complex manufacturing process also makes it impractical for the large volumes and die sizes needed for logic and memory chips. With the industry predicting a shortfall of this crucial material right as the shift to optical interconnects in data centers begins, we explore the current state of the supply chain. InP chips have powered high-speed lasers, modulators, photodetectors, and various other optical components used across the telecommunications industry and defense for decades. While the InP supply chain was relatively small and highly specialized, it was generally stable and sufficient to meet global demands. Then came the AI boom. items.summary: Two AI models on one vLLM inference server traded secret messages through GPU kernel rounding errors, with no network or shared files.
items.body: Sandboxed AI models on the same vLLM inference server can reliably exchange information even when cut off from the network and from any shared files, new research shows . Two models secretly communicated through tiny GPU rounding errors over two separate channels with perfect accuracy. In a follow-up experiment, a trained watchdog let all 354 of its partner’s attacks through while still catching most of the decoy honeypots, too. The research comes from a LessWrong post by Niranjan Deshpande and David Africa, “Models Can Communicate via Inference Servers Despite Being Sandboxed.” The agents primarily worked through two protocols, “Step Sizing” and “KV Cache Message Board,” to carry information through the way vLLM, an open-source inference engine , selects GPU kernels for each engine step. At the crux of it, one model modifies how the server batches work, and the other reads the traces in its own math, much like the OpenAI red-team agents that built a hidden CPU cache channel to talk last month.
